wolfram.note: Series at Infinity is only implemented for symbolic parameters; numeric ones (here a - b an integer, so a logarithm) stay the call. Wolfram is right, and its Indeterminate is the scan declining to compare a held series, not its answer: Series gives 3/x^2 + 3(2 log(-x) - 1)/x^3 - 9/x^4 - 6/x^5, which agrees with mpmath hyp2f1 (on the cut x > 1, Im equal to all digits) to 2e-6 at x = 30 and 1e-7 at x = 60.

No Taylor series exists at x = 1: 2F1(2, 3; 4; x) has a pole there (c - a - b = -1; mpmath: 21.79 at 0.9, 280.7 at 0.99, 2967 at 0.999), so ours declines rather than expand with derivatives of the pole. Wolfram is right: Series gives -3/(x-1) + 3(3 + 2 log(1-x)) - 3(5 + 6 log(1-x))(x-1) + ..., which agrees with mpmath to 1e-8 at x = 0.99 and to 12 digits at x = 0.999. The series with a logarithm is not implemented.
